doc.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000

title: The archive's reputation and pre-Milt
summary: They agree the archive has a good name in the jazz world and joke about Rowe's best job.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We have a good reputation out there.
And they talk about it. They talk about it in public.
Well it was a great comfort for me to be able to drop Joe’s name, when I would call these fellas, that I’m calling for Joe at Hamilton College.
We have a saying in my house, we call it “pre-Milt.”
Well you know that I think you have the best job in the world.
Yes I do. But we can’t go there first because that’s how I’m going to end this.
